name: 10-in-1 Deluxe Sparklers
description: Premium multi-colored hand sparklers that burn with slow, controlled, and low-smoke color streams.
safetyTip: Hold at arm length. Dispose of burned wire in a bucket of water.

name: Crackling Electric Sparklers
description: Generates a continuous crackling electric sound with bright white sparks, delighting all age groups.
safetyTip: Adult supervision required for children below 8 years.

name: Tri-Color Mega Flower Pots
description: Fires a three-stage fountain rising up to 10 feet. Transitions from ruby red to emerald green and finally silver crackling stars.
safetyTip: Place on flat level ground. Light using a sparkler, do not lean over it.

name: Asok Special Flower Pots
description: Classic gold shower fountain. Reliable, long-lasting, and creates a dense wall of glowing sparks.
safetyTip: Ensure there are no overhead branches or power lines before lighting.

name: Deluxe Ground Chakkars (Big)
description: Super-fast spinning ground wheels that create a dazzling, continuous ring of gold sparks.
safetyTip: Place flat on smooth ground. Step back immediately after lighting.

name: Color-Changing Disco Chakkars
description: Ground spinner that changes colors from gold to red and then green while spinning actively.
safetyTip: Do not light on dry leaves or grass.

name: Whistling Lunik Rockets
description: Shoots straight up into the air with a loud, high-pitched whistle, ending with a small silver shower.
safetyTip: Place the rocket stick vertically in a heavy bottle or launcher tube. Do not bury the stick in mud.

name: 30-Shot Aerial Symphony
description: Fires 30 consecutive premium shells that burst into dynamic chrysanthemums, silver palms, and crackling willow showers.
safetyTip: Ensure the box is braced securely with bricks on either side. Light from the side, step back 20 meters.

name: 120-Shot Crackling Rain
description: A rapid-firing block that fills the sky with an intense, continuous rain of silver crackles and multi-colored stars.
safetyTip: Keep spectators at a minimum of 25 meters distance. Use outdoors only.

name: Royal Gold Gift Box
description: Premium assortment box contains 35 high-quality, kid-friendly item packs including sparklers, pots, chakkars, and whistling rockets.
safetyTip: Store the box in a dry, cool place away from open flames.
